user_signal.goal_or_constraint: GitHub migration must yield real Agent products and a control plane that proactively detects architecture drift instead of waiting for the user to enumerate missing dimensions.
user_signal.proposed_mechanism: Use thin Skill/router plus executable Runtime, authoritative Workflow, owner-local Harness, progressive References, durable Continuity, and a Universal Signal Plane/Architecture Watch rather than a monolithic prompt or another role-only supervisory Agent.
user_signal.counterexample: After the initial rollout every BUSINESS owner HEAD moved, the observation cache became stale, Financial still had a roughly 20KB Skill before slimming, A-share and Video independently invented local architecture-contract 1.1 vocabulary, and the enabled watch had notification delivery disabled.

failure_classes: shared architecture vocabulary was too narrow, causing independent owner-local contract forks
remote owner observation freshness can drift even while local Universal CI remains green
Skill/router budget regressions can recreate prompt-centric systems after Agent runtimes already exist
watch enabled does not imply user notification delivery enabled
takeover changes manifest version and can stale the current meta-maintenance closure receipt if checkpoint surfaces are not rebound atomically

falsification_checks: Accept explicitly supported v1.0 owner manifests under Universal 1.1 while rejecting an unknown future manifest version.
Normalize only centrally enumerated A-share/Video 1.1 vocabulary and reject an unknown shared alias.
Normalize only approved v1.1 alternate field shapes and retain required-layer/reference checks.

Require oversized Skills to remain explicit PASS_WITH_DRIFT while missing runtime/workflow/harness remains FAIL.
Emit durable non-authoritative signals without taking owner leases and verify they do not mutate business truth.
Treat disabled product notification delivery as unproven rather than inferring it from an enabled condition-watch task.
Keep takeover/meta-run/manifest/cache version binding fail-closed instead of weakening the regression.

second_order_findings: Forcing owner-local 1.1 manifests back to 1.0 would hide a real underspecification in Universal; the shared need was distilled centrally instead.
Accepting arbitrary 1.1 vocabulary would turn compatibility into schema bypass; only explicit aliases and approved field shapes are normalized.
A watcher that cannot deliver product notifications still has value as a durable GitHub signal emitter, but that narrower guarantee must be stated explicitly.
Universal should detect/route owner drift, not become a cross-repository business writer; only Financial was safely slimmed during this run, while A-share/Novel/Video receive owner-scoped signals.
The first post-rollout observation set became stale immediately after owners evolved, proving remote freshness is an ongoing control-plane responsibility rather than a one-time rollout receipt.
Takeover caused meta-run/manifest version staleness; the fix preserves the strict binding and checkpoints the related surfaces atomically rather than weakening the test.

closure.unknown_or_open_world_boundary: This run proves only the covered architecture compatibility, remote re-observation, thin-router and signal-transport mechanisms at their stated evidence levels. It cannot prove global flawlessness, future notification delivery, automatic owner repair, or that every future Agent/model/tool/product failure class has been anticipated.
